blurb.bm: Jalan rumah kedai lama dengan mural, kedai antik dan muzium kecil.
blurb.en: A street of old shophouses with murals, antique shops and small museums.

ask.bm: Lebuh ini dinamakan sempena pedagang dari…
ask.en: This street is named after traders from…

why.bm: Ya! Dahulu ia dipanggil Malay Lane. Menjelang 1808 ia dinamakan Armenian Street kerana pedagang Armenia tinggal di sini.
why.en: Yes! It was once called Malay Lane. By 1808 it was renamed Armenian Street because Armenian traders lived here.

intro.bm: Lebuh Armenian ialah antara jalan seni jalanan paling terkenal di George Town.
intro.en: Armenian Street is one of George Town's best-known street-art streets.

bm: Jalan ini asalnya dipanggil Malay Lane, kemudian dinamakan Armenian Street menjelang 1808.
Pada 2012, artis Ernest Zacharevic melukis enam mural untuk George Town Festival, termasuk Children on a Bicycle.
Pada 1910, Sun Yat-sen mengetuai persidangan di sebuah rumah kedai di jalan ini. Kini ia Muzium Sun Yat-sen.
Muzium Islam Pulau Pinang terletak di hujung barat jalan ini.
en: It was first called Malay Lane, then renamed Armenian Street by 1808.
In 2012 the artist Ernest Zacharevic painted six murals for the George Town Festival, including Children on a Bicycle.
In 1910 Sun Yat-sen chaired a conference in a townhouse on this street. It is now the Sun Yat-sen Museum.
The Penang Islamic Museum stands at the street's western end.
The Children on a Bicycle mural

fun.bm: Zacharevic menggunakan orang tempatan sebagai model untuk mural-muralnya.
fun.en: Zacharevic used local people as models for his murals.
